description: Starts a paid takeoff on a project whose plan PDF was attached with attach_plan_pdf or uploaded by the user on the project page in Portravo. Each trade uses one takeoff credit (bought at $75); the whole job uses three ($149 pay as you go). Uses only existing plan allowance and purchased credits, never billed overage. Prerequisites: preflight_takeoff, the user's approval of its trades and creditsRequired, and an attached plan; set confirmed_trades to the approved selection and max_credits to the approved ceiling (defaults to one for older clients). A changed selection/cost or insufficient balance is refused before starting. Repeating a call with the same idempotency_key does not charge again. Returns asynchronous progress; use get_takeoff_status until done, then get_takeoff for source-linked human review. A completed run is not a bid-ready estimate. Failed provider runs refund the reservation; existing review work cannot be overwritten.
name: run_takeoff
title: Extract a construction plan takeoff
